description: R3 (K37, §19.9, §20): retraction of a story whose data proved wrong. A bad print makes a false breakout; a replica disputes the capsule; the settled bar contradicts it: upheld, the story goes to `retracted` (state `invalidated`), the transition reason is `dispute_upheld`, and the ledger never counts it. A repeated dispute is `duplicate`.
name: 43-capsule-retract
